about: The sprites of the event, news, pause-menu, options and Gathering Dark windows (UI overhaul lane W5, docs/plans/ui_overhaul/02_plan.md phase 2; design system docs/specs/07_interface/07_design_system.md sections 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 5, 6.1 to 6.3, 7). Every texture is cut by modules/ui_dialogs.mjs from an accepted lane C1 chrome sheet (art/source/ui/reskin/<sheet>.png, reviewed in art/source/provenance.jsonl): code only crops, reduces, repeats and places generated pixels and clears the inside of a picture frame. Each window draws its own textures, so a window takes its own theme even where vanilla shares a texture across areas (renders/C1/theme_conflicts.json): the event and news windows Chancery, the Gathering Dark history Chronicle, the pause menu, its load and save panels and the options neutral (K70; lead instruction for lane W5: menus are neutral).

notes.kind: cornered: a corneredTileSpriteType the engine stretches (size and border are the engine values); sprite: a spriteType of fixed size; button: a spriteType with one frame per state (normal, hover, pressed; design system 6.2); slice: a crop of a plate fitted at the size of a whole panel, so the pieces of one vanilla panel (top, list, bottom) join without a seam.
notes.fit: frame_tile (lib/fit.mjs): the cell is reduced until its painted rim is `frame` pixels and its body repeats from a seam-matched span; never enlarged. contain: an isolated control centred with padding.
notes.hollow: The frame's inside (inside `frame` pixels from every edge) is cleared, so the picture under it shows; nothing is painted.
